Key bugs:

But `ctypes.c_void_p(-1).value` — c_void_p(-1) may not be valid; c_void_p accepts int, and .value gives int. Actually `ctypes.c_void_p(-1)` works (int). OK. But `vector` — if length is 0 (size 0), mincore with 0 bytes... fine. Also mincore with length 0: mmap of length 0 fails. If size is 0, mmap fails with ENOMEM. Edge case.
